course.title: Project Management
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value:
Draw the “Earned value chart." Assume that operations on a work package were expected to 16   
cost \$1500 to complete the package. They were originally schedule to have been finished   
today. At this point, \$1350 has actually been expended. It is estimated that two-thirds of the   
work have been completed. Calculate CV, SV, CSI, ETC, and EAC.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
